slots.name: pavement test duration
slots.sentence: The charity also recommends the pavement test: if you can't comfortably hold your hand on the ground for five seconds, it's too hot for your dog's paws , external .

slots.name: sunscreen SPF
slots.sentence: Some active ingredients in human sun cream are toxic to pets so vets recommend using a pet-safe waterproof sunscreen, with an SPF rating of 30 or higher.

slots.name: patch test duration
slots.sentence: The PDSA suggests you apply sunscreen to a small area of skin first , external , and leave it for 24 hours to ensure the animal does not react.
